paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Moab tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kumpipa guhte sunu bang zen a ahal ziak in.
heading: Moab tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Moab tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Kerioth kumpipa guhte akang khin ding; huan Moab buaina leh kikou leh pengkul ging in asi ding hi.
Huai lak a kipan vaihawmmi ka hihmang ding a, amiliante tengteng, amah toh ka that ding," TOUPA'N achi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; TOUPA dan adeih kei ua, athupiakte azui kei uh, apate uh chih sek azuaugente un amaute apimang ziak in.
heading: Judah tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Judah tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding," chi in.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; dangkasik a midiktat azuak uleh khedap but khat a mitasam azuak ziak un.
heading: Israel tung thukhenna

paite: Gentheite leivui bang a sikden ut tuntun a, mizawngte vaihawmna akaikawi uhi; huan, mi khat leh apa nungak khat kiang ah ka min hihnin ding in ahoh zel uhi.
Maitam tengteng kiangchin a khamna puanphah tung ah alum zel ua, a Pathian uh inn a mi aliausakna mante un uain adawn zel uh," chi in.
"Himahleh amau ma a Amorte, Sidar bang a sang leh tosaw bang a khauh hihmang a; tunglam a kipan agah leh nuailam a kipan azung leng hihmangpa ka hi.
Huan Amorte gam nei ding in Aigupta gam a kipan in ka hon pikhia a, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung ka hon pi hi.
Huan zawlnei hi ding in na tapate uh lak a mi leh Nazaritte hi ding in na tangvalte uh lak a mi ka bawl a, Aw Israel suante aw, huchibang in ahi kei a hia? TOUPA'N achi.
Himahleh Nazarit mite kiang ah uain dawn ding na pia ua, zawlneite kiang ah, thu gen kei un, chi in thu na pia uhi.
Ngai dih ua, kangtalai a buhphal sawnsip bang in, na mun uah ka hon sawn ding hi.
Huan mitaihatte hatna amang ding a, mihat in tha asuah thei sam kei ding hi; mihat mahmah leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
Thalpeu zangmi leng adingh thei sam kei ding; paihat thei mi leng akihumbit thei kei ding, sakol tungtuangmi leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in mi thilhihthei mahmah lak a mihangsan leng vuaktang in ataimang ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
